data.name: ForestTalk
data.shortDescription: Actually talk to Kelvin and Virginia. Kelvin, now deaf, still has plenty to say. Chat through his notepad or hit O for a quick shortcut. Give him real in-game orders. Deep customization included.
data.description:
ForestTalk turns Kelvin and Virginia into real companions, not silent bots you just watch.

💬 How to talk to them
With Kelvin, open his notepad and press T to type. You can also press O while nearby and looking at him, no notepad needed. Virginia works the same way: get close, look at her, and press O, if she's willing.

🧠 Kelvin, your companion
I put a lot of effort into making him aware of his surroundings: nearby danger, your state, the weather, what he's doing. This mod assumes the crash left him deaf, but he can still speak. He's not a bot you click through, he's your companion, and he'll always have something to say. Warm personality, a bit shaken by what he's been through, with a strong moral compass against the forest.

You can also give him real orders through chat: bring logs, repair the camp, build a fire, stay put, follow you, and more. Real orders he carries out in-game.

🌿 Virginia, an independent soul
Virginia can talk with you too, on her own terms: a fully independent person. She can't be given orders or commands, she'll only chat if she feels like it.

⚠️ Real environmental awareness
Both react to what's actually happening: danger, injuries, hunger or thirst, night, rain. I dug deep into the game's code so this isn't a chat bolted on top, they react to what's going on with you.

👀 Bonus: let them see what you see
Type !look plus your message (e.g. !look what do you think of our base?) to send a screenshot along with it. A fun little extra, not required. Heads up: capturing it pauses the game for a split second.

⚙️ Deep customization
Choose between several AI providers: Player2 (a button to generate your API key instantly), OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, or your own custom/local server. Adjust how often they speak on their own, toggle danger comments, write custom personality notes, and more.

Surviving the forest is no longer something you do alone. Kelvin and Virginia become real friends to face the island with.

data.name: Unstuck Kelvin
data.shortDescription: Press K to teleport Kelvin in front of you.
data.description:
Description Kelvin keeps getting stuck. Press K to teleport him in front of you. Installation instructions - Install RedLoader if you haven't already. - Unzip to your game's main folder (where SonsOfTheForest.exe is located) maintaining the ZIP's folder structure. (The .DLL will end up under the Mods folder, and the .json under the Mods/RW18_unstuckKelvin folder.)

Main features Press K to teleport Kelvin in front of you when he gets stuck.

Requirements Must have RedLoader installed.

data.name: Tactical Gear Mod
data.shortDescription: This configurable client-side mod adds tactical gear to you and any other players in your game.
data.description: This mod adds lots of options related to cosmetic tactical gear, for both you and for co-op players. It's client-side meaning only you will see any changes on you or on others, but your friends can download the mod to see it too :) Check the mod settings to configure it to your taste. Settings are applied in certain specific circumstances, so expect to reload/rejoin to fully notice changes. It even works with the game's outfits! (Helmet mileage may vary, expect it to clip with armor if unhidden) Full options list: - Tactical vest - Helmet (dead corpse “hemlet” model by default) - FAST/Cutscene helmet model swap (requires helmet to be enabled) - Name tags for other players (displays Steam usernames, works best if you disable visible world icons in SOTF’s settings) - Hide backpacks (for a cleaner look) - Gloves (for first-person and co-op players) - "Old jacket" option, like Kelvin and cutscene guys wear. This is the only clothing piece that was designed for the gloves. - Balaclavas and/or sunglasses (to look like the intro pilot) - Hide equipped armor pieces (such as creepy or bone armor) - Option to give Kelvin his helmet back The binoculars break the first-person gloves, but changing outfits fixes them. Your PlayerLocation patch method worked, thank you GLaD0S, I love you <3 https://github.com/clairenheit/ArmorMod

data.name: DedicatedSuperuser
data.shortDescription: A mod made for dedicated servers to execute commands as a client
data.description:
This mod allows dedicated server owners to execute specific commands as clients.

How to use:
- Install the mod on your dedicated server.
- Add your Steam64 Id to the ownerswhitelist.txt
- Install the mod on your local game

> **Available commands:**
> SetTimeOfDay [Number]
> LockTimeOfDay [On/Off]
> Addcharacter [ChracterName] [Count]
> Killradius [Distance]
> ForceRain [light|medium|heavy|cloud|sunny]
> RegrowAllTrees
> SetGameTimeSpeed [Number]
> RemoveDead
**New Commands added by the mod:**
> ReviveKelvin
> ReviveVirginia

data.name: KelvinSeek
data.shortDescription: Adds the ability to talk with Kelvin using DeepSeek AI
data.description:
## KelvinSeek
### Deepseek-Powered Kelvin Mod for Sons of the Forest

Imagine asking kelvin one of these things

- "Kelvin can you get me some wood?"
- "Kelvin how are you feeling today?"
- "Its getting late, make a shelter real quick"

Now you can!

[Video demonstration](https://youtu.be/tcC9ammD8NU)

Seamlessly integrates into the Sons of the Forest game. By leveraging the capabilities of ChatGPT, Kelvin becomes more responsive and engaging, providing a unique gaming experience.

## Installation

1. Download the KelvinGPT mod
2. Drop the mod .zip in your game folder and extract
3. Launch the game and start enjoying the enhanced interaction with Kelvin.

## How to Use

1. In the game, approach Kelvin and press the "E" key to open the notepad.
2. Press the "T" key to activate text input mode.
3. Start typing anything you want, questions, commands or interactions with Kelvin and press Enter.

## Commands

The mods add 2 console commands
- askkelvin recieves a command and will send it to kelvin without you needing to open the notepad for example
`askkelvin Hello kelvin, can you get me some wood?`
- clearkelvinchathistory Clears the chat history with kelvin
`clearkelvinchathistory`

(These commands work on the last kelvin you talked to, so in order to use them you must first send a message to kelvin via notepad)

*Explore the world of Sons of the Forest in a whole new way with the KelvinSeek mod.*

( Previously known as KelvinGPT / Kelvin-GPT )

Disclaimer: Last update do not require you to use open ai / deepseek api key so all messages are sent to the sotf-mods server for processing which calls the external AI service and stores the message and response for future training purposes

data.name: SOTFEdit Companion
data.shortDescription: Companion mod for SOTFEdit that allows teleportation and live position updates
data.description:
This is a companion mod that allows the interaction between SOTFEdit, which can be found here:
https://github.com/codengine/SOTFEdit/releases/latest

and the game.

The features are:
-Live teleportation to POIs, items etc. through the Interactive Map of SOTFEdit
-Display the live position and rotation of the Player, Kelvin, Virginia and any network players
-Teleport your self to Kelvin/Virginia or both to your location
-Create custom POIs through an ingame menu (Default F8)
-Teleport to previously created custom POIs (Default F9)

All of those features require a connection from SOTFEdit to a Server which is started by the mod. The configuration for the Server can be found at "Mods" -> "SOTFEditCompanion".

If all goes well, nothing has to be configured and it is enough to just start a game and then connect through SOTFEdit.

data.name: Restless Kelvin
data.shortDescription: Kelvin will never take a break while he executes your orders with this mod
data.description:
When this mod is enabled, he will never again take a break while he executes the orders.

You can turn it on or off under Mods -> Restless Kelvin -> Settings.
